name: Terraform
subtitle: Infrastructure as code
creator: Mitchell Hashimoto at HashiCorp
description: You declare cloud resources such as servers, databases, DNS and buckets in HCL files. Terraform plans the changes and applies them through provider plugins for thousands of services, tracking real-world state in a state file.
useCases: Reviewing infrastructure changes in pull requests

concepts.explanation: Plugins that talk to AWS, GCP, Cloudflare and more.
The things you want to exist.
Inputs and results of a configuration.
Terraform's record of what exists; keep it remote and locked.

codeSamples.label: HCL

pairsWith.reason: Plan on PR, apply on merge

cons: BSL license and IBM ownership concern some teams

pricing.summary: CLI is free. HCP Terraform: free up to 500 managed resources; Essentials $0.10, Standard $0.47, Premium $0.99 per resource per month. OpenTofu is a free open-source fork.

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
